next_actions.pass: Preserve the reviewed local visit; continue short visits only when people are available. Collection is not identity or household memory acceptance.
next_actions.fail: Keep failures and earlier examples. Investigate the failed screen before requesting further speech.
next_actions.error: Stop microphone and owned work; preserve earlier examples, retry exact local save or resume with fresh consent. No cloud fallback.
next_actions.needs_evidence: Wait for voluntary human voices and independent adult review through the complete in-app flow; no agent microphone or fabricated consent.

hypothesis: Short, explicitly consented and reviewed fresh local visits yield independently labelled calibration examples without changing enrollment, transcribing speech, sending audio to cloud or enabling identity/memory.

configuration.roles: Four named family members, consenting unrelated guest adult, heldout-only adult short and supervised willing two-voice overlap controls. Never label unregistered family as unrelated unknown.
configuration.protocol: Development minimum12eligible/person and20eligible unrelated guest, from max4visits/role; each visit max12attempts, batch6, up to5seconds/clip, optional private local WAV. Heldout remains locked until all4profiles and development fit; later independently declared occasion, minimum25eligible/person,20unknown,20short+overlap with both represented, max6visits/role.
configuration.review: Adult/self labels before scores; preserve ineligible/technical/no-audio attempts. Exclude wrong/silly/unsure voices; delete their provisional audio/vector. Same-ID retry is idempotent; exact reused PCM never independent. Fresh questions instead of forced retakes.
configuration.authority: Execution/collection screen only, no measured identity accuracy. No voice matching threshold, memory write, model training, cloud speech or paid API from this visit. Cutoffs derived only from development; heldout scored once with frozen code/model/profile/cutoffs.
